mapper.select: SELECT so.shop_id AS shopId, so.platform_order_id AS platformOrderId, ao.currency AS currency, SUM(ao.refund_amount) AS amount FROM aftersale_order ao JOIN shop_order so ON ao.order_id = so.id WHERE ao.status IN ('REFUNDED', 'COMPLETED') AND ao.refund_amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY so.shop_id, so.platform_order_id, ao.currency

SELECT sd.shop_id AS shopId, sd.order_id AS platformOrderId, sr.currency AS currency, SUM(-sd.amount) AS amount FROM settlement_detail sd JOIN settlement_report sr ON sd.report_id = sr.id WHERE sd.fee_type = 'REFUND' AND sr.status = 'PARSED' AND sd.order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.shop_id, sd.order_id, sr.currency
